sources.title: Qwen3.8-4B-Distill-GGUF: Text-to-Text model — overview, use cases ...
sources.snippet: Overview Qwen3.8-4B-Distill-GGUF is a quantized GGUF format distribution of a knowledge-distilled 4-billion-parameter language model developed by empero-ai. The underlying base model is a full-parameter distillation of Qwen3.8 2.4T A95B into the Qwen3.5-4B architecture, trained on approximately 45,000 curated teacher traces from Empero's internal distillation datasets. sources.snippet: Welcome to the GitHub repository of the Qwen3.5 open model series, including Qwen3.5, Qwen3.6, and the latest Qwen3.8. Here, you can find official information about Qwen3.8, post your questions (Issues), and share your ideas with the community (Discussions).

sources.title: Empero — Independent AI Research Lab
sources.snippet: Empero is an independent AI research lab in Germany building small, efficient language models you can own and run yourself. Latest: Qwen3.8 distilled to 9B / 4B / 2B, and a GDN-aware 27B Ridge GGUF at 11.7 GiB. 1M+ downloads on Hugging Face.
